messages:
Anya: Heads up — onboarding for tenant acme-inc failing. SCIM calls return 400 on /Users create.
Devon: Logs?
Anya: grabbing from prod-provisioner (snippet):
```
2026-03-20T21:03:12Z ERROR provisioner: scim/post /Users -> 400
reason=invalid_saml_assertion details="assertion appears truncated"
kms: decrypt failed: context-mismatch
```
Marc: hmm — 'assertion appears truncated' + kms context mismatch.. Could be IdP is chunking large SAML responses and our proxy recombines incorrectly.
Tasha (oncall): @Anya can you paste the raw SAML (redact PII) ?
Anya: pasted to #eng-security-private (shortened). Key clues: assertion size ~78KB, contains line breaks inside base64 block.
Devon: Our HTTP framework treats headers/reads differently when body contains CRLF sequences — proxy may split. Also KMS context-mismatch could be because the provisioner uses tenant_id in encryption context; if the assertion was modified newline->space, the ciphertext won't match on decrypt.
Marc: Repro steps: 1) Fetch SAML from IdP (acme-inc test) 2) run `base64 -d` -> should be valid XML 3) try KMS decrypt with stored ciphertext from S3.
InfraBot: Runbook triggered: ticket #INC-4821 created.
Tasha (oncall): Ran quick decrypt in staging:
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://enc.bin --encryption-context Tenant=acme-inc
Error: Decryption failed: InvalidEncryptionContext
```
Devon: That confirms context mismatch. Possibly IdP inserted spurious whitespace during relay. We should accept multiple canonicalizations before decrypting (trim CRLFs) as a short-term fix.
Marc: Long-term: ask IdP to stop chunking base64. Also add defensive normalization in provisioner: strip whitespace inside Assertion base64 before decrypt/verify, and log when assertion length > 64k.
Anya: For now I'll add a temporary preprocessor. I'll also start a SCIM backfill for affected users + file a KMS rotation task if we can't safely canonicalize.
sec-bot: vuln triage: severity=P2. Potential data leak? low. Action: add logging and alert on >50 failures.
Tasha (oncall): I've DM'd acme support and idp admin. They acknowledged and are spinning up a fix. ETA 6 hours.
Devon: Assigning action items: @Anya add preprocessor, @Marc add unit test, @Tasha track idp fix, @Infra create KMS-rotate subtask.
Anya: working on preprocessor PR, pushing to staging in 30m :thumbsup:
Marc: I'll review. Add a regression test with newline-in-base64.
Tasha (oncall): closing loop — will update ticket.
